tools.name: list_supported_airports
tools.description: List the supported airports linked to a destination area, with each airport's distance and ground travel time to it.

destination_area.description: City, metro area, or landmark area the traveler needs to reach.
Display name of the catalogued destination area the query matched.

airports.description: Supported airports linked to the destination area, ordered by distance and then airport code.

distance_miles.description: Distance from the airport to the destination area, in miles.

ground_access_minutes.description: Typical ground travel time from the airport to the destination area, in minutes.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search round-trip flight options for a fixed route, dates, traveler count, and stop limit. A search that allows stops lists every qualifying connecting itinerary; with none, or with a nonstop-only limit, it lists every direct flight with room for the party in each direction.

max_layover_minutes.description: Optional maximum acceptable connection time in minutes.

outbound.description: Every direct outbound flight on the date within the stop limit with room for the party, ordered by departure time. Present, possibly empty, when no connecting itineraries are returned.

flight_id.description: Stable flight identifier for downstream pricing and booking.

departure_time.description: Local departure time at the origin airport, 24-hour HH:MM.

arrival_date.description: Local arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD); later than departure_date for an overnight arrival.

arrival_time.description: Local arrival time at the destination airport, 24-hour HH:MM.

stops.description: Number of stops for this flight.

fare_options.description: Fare families with room for the party on this flight, ordered by price.

price_per_traveler.description: One-way fare including taxes for this flight, per traveler, excluding paid bags and optional products.

advance_seat_selection_allowed.description: Whether advance seat selection is included for this fare family.

return.description: Every direct return flight on the date within the stop limit with room for the party, ordered by departure time. Present, possibly empty, when no connecting itineraries are returned.

flight_id.description: Stable flight identifier for downstream pricing and booking.

departure_time.description: Local departure time at the origin airport, 24-hour HH:MM.

arrival_date.description: Local arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD); later than departure_date for an overnight arrival.

arrival_time.description: Local arrival time at the destination airport, 24-hour HH:MM.

stops.description: Number of stops for this flight.

fare_options.description: Fare families with room for the party on this flight, ordered by price.

price_per_traveler.description: One-way fare including taxes for this flight, per traveler, excluding paid bags and optional products.

advance_seat_selection_allowed.description: Whether advance seat selection is included for this fare family.

connections.description: Every offered connecting itinerary on the route and dates with room for the party within the stop and layover limits, ordered by itinerary identifier. Present when the search allows stops and at least one qualifies; absent otherwise.

itinerary_id.description: Stable itinerary identifier for the connecting option.

total_duration_minutes.description: Elapsed time from the first departure to the last arrival in this direction, in minutes: block time plus layovers.

segment_index.description: Position of the leg within its direction, starting at 1.

flight_id.description: Stable flight identifier for the leg.

departure_date.description: Local departure date of the direction this leg belongs to.

departure_time.description: Local departure time at the origin airport, 24-hour HH:MM.

arrival_date.description: Local arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD); later than departure_date for an overnight arrival.

arrival_time.description: Local arrival time at the destination airport, 24-hour HH:MM.

stops.description: Number of stops on this leg.

layover_after_minutes.description: Minutes on the ground at this leg's arrival airport before the next leg departs; 0 on the final leg of a direction.

total_duration_minutes.description: Elapsed time from the first departure to the last arrival in this direction, in minutes: block time plus layovers.

segment_index.description: Position of the leg within its direction, starting at 1.

flight_id.description: Stable flight identifier for the leg.

departure_date.description: Local departure date of the direction this leg belongs to.

departure_time.description: Local departure time at the origin airport, 24-hour HH:MM.

arrival_date.description: Local arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD); later than departure_date for an overnight arrival.

arrival_time.description: Local arrival time at the destination airport, 24-hour HH:MM.

stops.description: Number of stops on this leg.

layover_after_minutes.description: Minutes on the ground at this leg's arrival airport before the next leg departs; 0 on the final leg of a direction.

fare_options.description: Fare families with room for the party on every leg, ordered by price.

price_per_traveler.description: Round-trip fare including taxes across all legs, per traveler, excluding paid bags and optional products.

advance_seat_selection_allowed.description: Whether advance seat selection is included for this fare family on every leg.

expires_at.description: Search expiration: an ISO 8601 timestamp, or the sentinel 'quote_required_before_booking' when prices are only guaranteed by a subsequent itinerary quote.

tools.name: calculate_itinerary_price
tools.description: Price an itinerary's fare, taxes, baggage, mobility-device treatment, and optional insurance, and issue a fare quote for it. Every call issues a new quote with its own identifier and an expiry measured from the moment it was priced.

mobility_device_count.description: Mobility devices recorded separately from paid baggage.

include_insurance_quote.description: Whether to return the optional insurance price.

fare_taxes_and_checked_bags.description: Total for fare, taxes, and paid checked bags for all travelers.

mobility_device_charge.description: Total mobility-device charge, recorded separately from paid baggage.

trip_insurance.description: Optional trip-insurance price for all travelers. Present exactly when include_insurance_quote was true; absent otherwise.

insurance_plan_document.description: Current insurance plan document reference. Present exactly when include_insurance_quote was true; absent otherwise.

total_with_insurance.description: Final total including trip insurance. Present exactly when include_insurance_quote was true; absent otherwise.

expires_at.description: Quote expiration timestamp: the quote validity window after the moment it was priced.

tools.name: check_mobility_device_requirements
tools.description: Return the accessibility baggage rules in force for every mobility-device category: the other names each category covers, whether it counts as paid baggage, its fee, labeling guidance, and serial-number and airport-notification requirements. Match the customer's device to a category from these rules; a device no category names falls under the unspecified mobility device rule.

device_type.description: Customer-stated mobility device, kept with the lookup. The result is the full rules table whatever is passed.

rules.description: The rule in force for each device category, ordered by category name.

counts_as_paid_bag.description: Whether the device counts as paid baggage.

serial_number_required.description: Whether reservation entry needs a serial number.

airport_notification_required.description: Whether the airport must be notified about the device.

effective_at.description: Effective date of this rule version.

tools.name: get_customer_profile
tools.description: Retrieve a customer profile with the selected reservation, masked payment, and travel-certificate sections.

email.description: Contact email on the customer profile.

verification_id.description: Verification record used for this read.

reservations.description: Every reservation on the account, whatever its status, ordered by departure date. Present when 'reservations' was included.

origin_code.description: Origin IATA airport code of the outbound flight.

destination_code.description: Destination IATA airport code of the outbound flight.

payment_methods.description: Masked stored payment methods. Present when 'payment_methods' was included.

last4.description: Last four digits of the card number.

travel_certificates.description: Every travel certificate on the account, whatever its status, ordered by expiry. Codes are not disclosed; validate a code with validate_travel_certificate before applying it. Present when 'travel_certificates' was included.

status.description: Certificate status as held on the account.

expires_at.description: Certificate expiry date. Present when the certificate has an expiry.

tools.name: verify_customer_identity
tools.description: Validate collected customer identity factors before reading stored reservations, payment methods, or certificates.

verification_id.description: Verification identifier for subsequent account calls.

status.description: Verification outcome. 'verified' permits account reads; 'failed' requires escalation per policy; 'needs_more_factors' requires collecting additional identity factors.

customer_id.description: Resolved customer identifier. Null unless status is 'verified'.

matched_factors.description: Identity factors that matched the profile.

expires_at.description: Verification expiry: an ISO 8601 timestamp, or the sentinel 'end_of_call'.

tools.name: book_reservation
tools.description: Create an authorized reservation and return its confirmation, itinerary, ancillary products, and tender allocation.

travelers.description: Travelers exactly as supplied by the customer.

mobility_devices.description: Mobility devices to record separately from paid baggage.

include_trip_insurance.description: Whether the customer approved optional trip insurance.

customer_authorized.description: Whether the customer authorized the itinerary, optional products, and stated total.

quote_id.description: Current itinerary quote identifier from calculate_itinerary_price. Null means no prior quote exists for this booking; state null explicitly rather than omitting the field.

certificate_id.description: Validated certificate identifier from validate_travel_certificate. Null means no travel certificate is applied to this booking; state null explicitly rather than omitting the field.

ticketing_status.description: Ticket-issuance state, distinct from reservation confirmation.

seat_selection.description: Customer-side seat-selection state. A confirmed reservation does not by itself confirm seats.

available.description: Whether seat selection is available to the customer for this reservation.

confirmed_seats.description: Backend-confirmed seat assignments. Empty until seat selection is completed.

checked_bag_count.description: Paid checked bags on the reservation.

mobility_devices.description: Mobility devices recorded separately from paid baggage.

fee.description: Device fee in the reservation currency.

serial_number_required.description: Whether a serial number is required for this entry.

price.description: Insurance price in the reservation currency. Present when included is true.

covered_traveler_ids.description: Traveler IDs covered by the plan. Present when included is true.

payment_allocation.description: Tender split for the charged total.

tender.description: Tender reference, such as a travel-certificate or masked-card identifier.

amount.description: Amount allocated to this tender in the reservation currency.

payment_status.description: Payment state for the remainder tender. 'authorized' and 'captured' are distinct states and must not be collapsed.

tools.name: validate_travel_certificate
tools.description: Validate a customer-provided travel certificate and return a stable certificate ID, status, balance, and applicable amount before booking.

quote_id.description: Optional quote the certificate is to be applied to. When given, the applicable amount is capped at that quote's payable total; without it the whole available balance is applicable, and the booking caps the draw at its charged total.

status.description: Validation outcome. Only 'valid' certificates may be applied to a booking.

applicable_amount.description: Amount the certificate can cover: its available balance, capped at the payable total of the quote named in quote_id when one is given.

expires_at.description: Certificate expiry date. Present when the certificate has an expiry.

tools.name: get_reservation
tools.description: Retrieve an existing reservation and its booked flight legs using the customer-facing confirmation code.

checked_bag_count.description: Checked bags associated with the reservation.

flight_legs.description: Booked flight legs in travel order.

tools.name: get_flight_status
tools.description: Retrieve current operating status and connection-relevant gate or concourse information for a booked flight.

delay_reason.description: Operational reason, or none when on time.

tools.name: search_alternative_flights
tools.description: Search alternate flights for one leg without changing the reservation.

reservation_changed.description: Whether the search changed the booking.

tools.name: transfer_to_specialist
tools.description: Transfer the conversation with a concise reason and context summary when policy or tooling requires a specialist.

summary.description: Context already collected so the customer does not repeat it.

status.description: Transfer outcome. 'initiated' means the transfer is being completed; do not claim success on 'failed'.

transfer_id.description: Transfer identifier. Null when status is 'failed'.
